text:
Renee (CS): Heads-up team — running a 5-seat seed activation roundtable next week to validate the enrolment flow, capture enablement gaps, and immediately flag renewal risks. Need owners for invites, live notes, and post-call follow-ups.
Tom (PM): Proposed single-day block Thu 10-2 PT with 25-min slots. Goal metrics: time-to-first-success, activation confidence (1-5), and binary deal-breaker flag. @Luis can you take the infra slot?
Luis (SE): I can do the 11:20 slot. I'll bring a one-pager of fast-unblocks and SSO troubleshooting. Quick note for Okta/SCIM: set `provisioning.scim.enabled=true` in the onboarding YAML to avoid duplicated accounts. Snippet I'll paste into the runbook.
Grace (Research): For capture, let's use a tight 6-question micro-survey + a short call rubric. I'll publish the survey and the call script. Survey link: https://forms.redwood.com/seed-activation-2025. I'll include fields: TTFS (hours), activation_confidence 1-5, deal_breaker yes/no, free_text.
Renee (CS): Plan: 5-min intro, 10-min guided setup, 10-min structured feedback. Post-call: send Loom + micro-survey within 12h. Owners: Renee = invites & Loom, Luis = SSO & quick remediation doc, Grace = survey + export, Tom = compile highlights and tag renewal-risk signals (SSO, data residency, perf).
Luis (SE): SAML note for enterprise customers: ensure AssertionConsumerService uses https and `NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`. For air-gapped demos include `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` in helm.
Tom (PM): If activation_confidence <=2 or deal_breaker = yes -> immediate renewal-risk tag. We'll create a triage card: fields = customer, observed_issue, severity (low/med/high), owner, ETA for mitigation. P0 infra items route to runtime-oncall.
SchedulerBot: Calendar batch created: Seed Activation Roundtable  Thu 2025-11-06 10:00-14:00 PT. Slots: 25-min x5. Attendees prefilled: Renee, Tom, Luis, Grace. Meet links attached.
Renee (CS): Need two volunteers for note-taking across slots and one person to triage renewal-risk flags live. I'll DM the roster once seats confirm.
Grace (Research): I'll add a short consent checkbox on the survey for opt-in quotes (case study permission) and will export CSV with tagged quotes for CS handoff.
Luis (SE): I'll prepare a 2-slide "Known issues & workarounds" and share it before the session. Also will paste the minimal YAML snippet: `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true`
Tom (PM): Remind: capture a single-line "activation blocker" summary for any deal-breaker so Sales can triage with the customer immediately. We'll aim to close quick-fixes within 48h.
Renee (CS): Perfect. Post-call deliverables: Loom + survey (12h), export results (Grace), compile top-3 friction items and map to quick wins vs backlog (Tom), notify Sales if renewal-risk flagged. If legal/data residency concerns appear, loop Legal + Sales immediately.
Luis (SE): Quick debug command I'll include in runbook: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-demo | grep provision` to capture provisioning errors.
Renee (CS): Thanks all 44D I'll post the roster and an owner checklist in ~20m. Ping me if you want to sit on any live slots.
